gates.failedTest: test/fixtures-tier/guided-secret-ownership.test.ts > uses actual mTLS and native focus for guided secret ownership: hard-expiry. AssertionError at line 130: expected stopReason 'LEASE_LOST' to be 'EXPIRED'. Test took 5.07 s. The other 3 modes (revoked, slow-grant, lost-body-late-grant) passed.
gates.classification: TRANSIENT [inference, not a proof]. Evidence: (1) the same test passed in final-gates05 (test file and ownership.ts unchanged since; neither is in the 13-file W10 diff) and in Dex's W10 full fixtures run on N24 (w10-review-fixes01/gates/fixtures-full.*: 260 passed / 0 failed / 9 skipped, hard-expiry passed in 5065 ms), which looks like the same tree; (2) mechanism: the test sets expiresAt = now+5 s. In src/guided/ownership.ts the renewal path throws LEASE_LOST when the remaining lease minus 100 ms is not positive (line 80), while the expiry timer (line 54) reports EXPIRED. A renewal landing in the last 100 ms before expiry stops the session first with LEASE_LOST, so the outcome depends on renewal phase (about a 100 ms window in each 1000 ms renewal period). I did not prove the race by instrumentation. The W10 changes to runtime.ts and guidedMain.ts are not excluded as a contributing factor, because I did not rerun. Rule applied: transient, not rerun, reported.
